query:
SELECT COUNT(*) AS n
FROM gaiadr3.gaia_source
WHERE pm > 35
AND bp_rp < 1.2
AND parallax_over_error < -3
AND 4.74047 * pm > 1000 * ABS(parallax)
AND phot_g_mean_mag + 5 * LOG10(ABS(parallax)) - 10 > 3.5
